author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Ninety! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Patso Catso has been busily sculpting and developing possibly the cutest printable Sci-Fi game in the indie-sphere. The Block and Sphere nations are at war in the new BLOCKWAR as the Cylindrians lurk in the wings. Let's check it out!

Check out the the game rules for FREE HERE:https://www.patreon.com/c/theBlockWar/home
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 090 - The Blockwar by Patso Catso
